  gt$heights[pp$t] <- grid::unit(panel_height, unit)

# Introduction
This report collects code for analysing dFORCE data.

---

# m6A sites processing
The raw pod5 files were basecalled with tool `dorado`. The modification basecalling model 
`rna004_130bps_sup@v5.2.0 m6A DRACH` was used for m6A detection.

The m6A sites which detected in at least two replicates in a certain condition are considered as 
the high confident m6A sites and therefore used in the following analysis. The cutoff for m6A sites 
are coverage > 5 & stoichiometry > 20.

```{r}
path_f <- "~/Desktop/Data/Julian_lab/Miona/Nanopore/PlaB_dFORCE/m6A/"
all_f <- list.files(path_f)

for (i in 1:length(all_f)) {
    if (i == 1) {
        all_sites <- read_nanopore_bed(paste0(path_f, all_f[[i]]))
        all_sites$sample <- sub("_filtered.*", "", all_f[[i]]) %>%
            sub("HEK293T_dFirce_", "", .) %>%
            sub("HEK293T_dForce_", "", .) %>%
            sub("dForce_", "", .)
    } else {
        tmp <- read_nanopore_bed(paste0(path_f, all_f[[i]]))
        tmp$sample <- sub("_filtered.*", "", all_f[[i]]) %>%
            sub("HEK293T_dFirce_", "", .) %>%
            sub("HEK293T_dForce_", "", .) %>%
            sub("dForce_", "", .)
        all_sites <- rbind(all_sites, tmp)
    }
}

all_sites <- all_sites %>% mutate(
    condition = case_when(
      str_detect(sample, "PlaB_STM|STM_PlaB") ~ "PlaB.STM",
      str_detect(sample, "DMSO")              ~ "DMSO",
      str_detect(sample, "PlaB")              ~ "PlaB",
      str_detect(sample, "STM")               ~ "STM",
      TRUE                                    ~ NA_character_
    )
)

all_sites$rep <- sub(".*_", "", all_sites$sample) 
all_sites$rep <- case_when(all_sites$rep %in% c("2h", "1") ~ "rep1",
                      T ~ all_sites$rep)
all_sites$m6A <- all_sites$Stoichiometry > 20
m6A_all <- all_sites[all_sites$m6A == T,] 

## m6A presented in at least two reps as detected m6A sites
m6A_all$ID_2 <- paste0(m6A_all$ID, "_", m6A_all$condition)

n_id <- table(m6A_all$ID_2) %>% as.data.frame(.)
n_id$condition <- sub(".*_", "", n_id$Var1)
n_id$ID <- sub("_.*", "", n_id$Var1)
## keep ID in more than two replicates
n_id_f <- n_id[n_id$Freq >= 2,]
```

```{r}
## function to make m6A GRange object from ID
make_m6A_gr <- function(ID, info){
    ## make coordinate df
    df <- data.frame(seqnames = sub(":.*", "", ID$ID),
                     start = getstr(ID$ID, ":", 1, " ", 1),
                     end = getstr(ID$ID, ":", 1, " ", 1),
                     strand = sub(".* ", "", ID$ID),
                     ID = ID$ID,
                     condition = ID$condition)
    test_rep <- c("rep1", "rep2", "rep4")
    unique_condition <- unique(ID$condition)
    ## assign information
    for (i in 1:length(unique_condition)) {
    used_info <- info[info$condition == unique_condition[[i]],]
    
    ## loop through all reps

    
    for (i in seq_len(length(test_rep))) {
        tmp_info <- used_info[used_info$rep == test_rep[[i]],]
        ## new column names
        name1 <- paste0(unique(tmp_info$condition), "_", unique(tmp_info$rep), "_", "N_cov")
        name2 <- paste0(unique(tmp_info$condition), "_", unique(tmp_info$rep), "_", "stoi")
        
        ## assign value
        df[[name1]] <- tmp_info$N_valid_cov[match(
            df$ID, tmp_info$ID
        )]
        df[[name2]] <- tmp_info$Stoichiometry[match(
            df$ID, tmp_info$ID
        )]
    }
    }
    out <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(df, keep.extra.columns = T)
    return(out)
}

```

```{r}
## make m6A
m6A_all <- make_m6A_gr(n_id_f, all_sites)

## calculate mean
m6A_all <- as.data.frame(m6A_all) %>%
  mutate(
    DMSO_mean_cov = rowMeans(across(matches("^DMSO_rep[0-9]+_N_cov$")), na.rm = TRUE),
    DMSO_mean_stoi = rowMeans(across(matches("^DMSO_rep[0-9]+_stoi$")), na.rm = TRUE),

    PlaB_mean_cov = rowMeans(across(matches("^PlaB_rep[0-9]+_N_cov$")), na.rm = TRUE),
    PlaB_mean_stoi = rowMeans(across(matches("^PlaB_rep[0-9]+_stoi$")), na.rm = TRUE),

    PlaB.STM_mean_cov = rowMeans(across(matches("^PlaB\\.STM_rep[0-9]+_N_cov$")), na.rm = TRUE),
    PlaB.STM_mean_stoi = rowMeans(across(matches("^PlaB\\.STM_rep[0-9]+_stoi$")), na.rm = TRUE),

    STM_mean_cov = rowMeans(across(matches("^STM_rep[0-9]+_N_cov$")), na.rm = TRUE),
    STM_mean_stoi = rowMeans(across(matches("^STM_rep[0-9]+_stoi$")), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      ends_with(c("_mean_cov", "_mean_stoi")),
      ~ replace(.x, is.nan(.x), NA_real_)
    )
  )

m6A_all <- m6A_all[order(m6A_all$condition),]
m6A_all <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(m6A_all, keep.extra.columns = T)
m6A_all <- m6A_all[seqnames(m6A_all) %in% standardChromosomes(m6A_all)]
```

## assigned_to

```{r}
m6A_all <- dis_to_SS_v2(m6A_all, hg38, width_bs = 1) %>% suppressWarnings(.)
m6A_all <- as.data.frame(m6A_all) %>% 
    mutate(assigned_to = case_when(transcript_id == trans_id_intron ~ "Intron",
                                   transcript_id == trans_id_exon ~ "Exon",
                                   T ~ "Not assigned")) %>%
    makeGRangesFromDataFrame(., keep.extra.columns = T)

p1 <- ggplot(as.data.frame(m6A_all),
       aes(x = condition, fill = assigned_to)) + 
    geom_bar(position = "dodge")  +
    labs(x = NULL) + 
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
p2 <- ggplot(as.data.frame(m6A_all),
       aes(x = condition, fill = assigned_to)) + 
    geom_bar(position = "fill") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Fraction") + 
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
p1+p2
```

## Distance to SS stoi

```{r}
m6A_all$bin_dis_SS <- cut(m6A_all$dis_SS, breaks = c(0,50,100,200,Inf))
## make Stoichiometry column for plotting
m6A_all$Stoichiometry <- case_when(m6A_all$condition == "DMSO" ~ m6A_all$DMSO_mean_stoi,
                                   m6A_all$condition == "STM" ~ m6A_all$STM_mean_stoi,
                                   m6A_all$condition == "PlaB" ~ m6A_all$PlaB_mean_stoi,
                                   m6A_all$condition == "PlaB.STM" ~ m6A_all$PlaB.STM_mean_stoi)

ggplot(as.data.frame(m6A_all[m6A_all$assigned_to != "Not assigned" &
                                 !is.na(m6A_all$bin_dis_SS),]),
    aes(x = condition, y = Stoichiometry, fill = bin_dis_SS)) + 
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + 
    facet_wrap(~assigned_to) + 
    labs(x = NULL)
```
